(9) Contributions for voluntary membership in professional and trade associations shall be deductible only under the following conditions:  
— The professional and trade associations must, according to their statutes and actual management, be exclusively or predominantly concerned with representing the business and professional interests of their members.  
— The contributions may be deducted only in an appropriate amount as stipulated in the statutes.
